subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage.
guide_solution: Summary Email is the best way of communication in the present world. It is an electronic mail which works through a network of computers linked by the Internet. Its work is to exchange digital text messages from a sender to one or multiple recipients. It works instantly with just a click of the mouse. If the recipient is not online, the message will be stored in his digital mailbox. However, for its easy use and instant service it has become popular and necessary like a cup of coffee/tea in the morning.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Rangpur Govt. Girls' High School. Sl. No. 51; Page No. 101
